purpose: Read only the ZIP central directory of the frozen 48-site USA+Canada SeagrassNet download, treating server-generated attachment UUIDs as non-identity metadata.
identity_rule: Require frozen candidate UUID hash, HTTP 2xx HEAD, application/zip, and a valid central directory. Ignore only the random UUID token in Content-Disposition filename.
stop_rule: If Range is not honored with HTTP 206, if central directory is incomplete/malformed/ZIP64, or candidate hash changes, stop before member payload access.
